messages:
Priya Nair: apac-east rack-7 showing intermittent p95 spikes and NVLink contention since 04:14. Looks like one tenant doing continuous long-context streaming + aggressive KV warming.

Tom Bell: saw the alert. NIC bursts + nvlink_util high. Which tenant id?

Priya Nair: tid-6024 (third-party eval). infra bot fired at 04:15 with slab_evictions + cpu/io jitter.

InfraBot: ALERT rack-7: nvlink 92%, nic_tx 880MB/s, slab_evictions +350%. Incident INC-9997 created.

Mei Lin: quick mitigation: soft-rate-limit and reduce max_context. We have knobs: rate_limit_tokens_per_sec and max_context_tokens.

Tom Bell: apply this patch:
```
tenantctl set --tenant=tid-6024 --rate_tps=1200 --max_context=8192
rackctl set --rack=apac-east-7 --nic_shaper_mb=850
```
That should reduce NVLink backpressure and NIC bursts.

Carlos Ruiz: prefer soft-fence into noisy-pool instead of immediate migration. Cheaper short-term and gives ops time. Add automation: if slab_evictions stay >200% for 15m after soft-fence -> schedule carveout.

Priya Nair: doing actions now. InfraBot please apply.

InfraBot: ACTION executed: tenant rate and context changed; rack nic shaper updated. Monitoring: https://telemetry.redwood/apac-east/rack-7/INC-9997

(40s) Tom Bell: telemetry shows nic down ~30%, nvlink down 20%. p95 latencies falling.

Mei Lin: note for runbook: recommend dev guide update: "For shared racks: avoid sustained streaming with >4 concurrent streams at max context; request dedicated capacity for long-lived decoding workloads."

Carlos Ruiz: I'll open OPS ticket to add auto-soft-fence rule and customer billing note for repeated noisy behavior.

Priya Nair: tagging tid-6024 for postmortem and cost review. Closing thread after 30m stable. :thumbsup:
